title: Trust-Root Model for Capability Descriptor Signatures
rationale: R0 ships Ed25519 signatures on CapabilityDescriptor (ADR-0023) but no revocation and no chain — a compromised key is trusted forever. This spec defines the TrustStore model that ADR-0031 ratifies: a single trust-root anchors an optional 2-level authority chain, a signed RevocationList catches compromised keys, and bounded chain depth (cap = 2) prevents runaway delegation. Closes the R0 risk 'no adversary model for signed descriptors' (WORKLOG.md:107).
acceptance_signals: fabric_capability::trust_root::TrustStore::new(root) constructs a store from a TrustRoot Authority

fabric_capability::trust_root::TrustStore::verify_chain(descriptor) returns Ok(ChainVerification) when the descriptor is signed by a key whose Authority chain is anchored at the TrustRoot and not revoked
verify_chain returns Err(TrustError::KeyRevoked) when the signing key's key_id appears in the active RevocationList
verify_chain returns Err(TrustError::Expired) when the leaf Authority.not_after < now
verify_chain returns Err(TrustError::ChainTooDeep) when the chain depth exceeds the cap (2 in R1)
verify_chain returns Err(TrustError::UnknownAuthority) when the signature key_id is not in the TrustStore
R0 verify() / sign() / has_trusted_signature() API is unchanged (backwards compatible)
